title: Where does an element go, tile-major?
hints: Which tile: `row / 16` tile rows down and `col / 16` tile columns across. There are `cols / 16` tiles per row of tiles.
Each tile is 256 elements, so tile number `k` starts at `256 * k`.
Inside the tile: `(row mod 16) * 16 + col mod 16`.
explain: Tile-major order keeps each 16×16 tile in 256 consecutive elements, so every tile starts at a multiple of 256: 256 bytes for i8, comfortably aligned for the tensor cores. The tiles themselves go in row-major order, `cols / 16` of them per row of tiles. Element `(17, 3)` of a 32×32 matrix is in tile row 1, tile column 0, so tile 2, at row 1 and column 3 inside it: `2 * 256 + 1 * 16 + 3 = 531`.
